compiled_state.title: [debug-everything]: PR created with merge conflicts -> session ends without rebase/conflict resolution
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

In session 2026-05-05, /dso:debug-everything Bug-Fix Mode + Phase L created PR #52 (worktree-20260505-185224 → main) and ended the session without checking PR mergeability state. PR #52 was CONFLICTING (mergeStateStatus: DIRTY) on creation. The session never:

1. Polled for the post-PR-create mergeable state
2. Detected the CONFLICTING flag
3. Rebased the branch on main and resolved conflicts
4. Pushed the resolution

User had to flag the gap manually.

## Expected Behavior

Per Phase L (Merge to Main & Verify) of /dso:debug-everything, the session should not be considered complete until the PR is in a mergeable state. Under merge.strategy=pr:

- After 'gh pr create' returns, poll PR mergeable state
- If mergeable=CONFLICTING / mergeStateStatus=DIRTY: invoke /dso:resolve-conflicts (or rebase + auto-resolution flow) before declaring the session complete
- Do not return control to the user with a knowingly-conflicting PR — that defeats the purpose of automating Phase L

## Actual Behavior

After 'gh pr create' returned the PR URL, the session reported 'PR created' and emitted a final summary as if the work was done. Subsequent 'gh pr view 52 --json mergeable' showed mergeable=CONFLICTING. The conflicts (likely against ticket-tracker SNAPSHOT files updated on main during the session) require a rebase + manual or agent-driven resolution.

## Affected Paths

- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md — Phase L Step 2 (Report Completion) currently does not gate on PR mergeable state under merge.strategy=pr
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/prompts/phase-10-merge-verify.md — likely missing the post-PR-create mergeable check + resolve-conflicts dispatch when CONFLICTING

## Suggested Fix Direction

In Phase L (PR-mode path), after 'gh pr create' returns:

1. Poll 'gh pr view <num> --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus' — wait up to 30s for GitHub to compute mergeability (CONFLICTING / MERGEABLE / UNKNOWN)
2. If CONFLICTING / DIRTY: invoke /dso:resolve-conflicts (or a structurally-equivalent rebase + auto-resolve loop) before declaring session complete
3. Only emit the 'session complete' summary after mergeability is MERGEABLE (or after the resolution loop has been attempted and the PR is back in a mergeable state)

Closes the gap surfaced in 2026-05-05 session: PR #52 was created CONFLICTING and the session ended without resolution.
